jobgether-jobgether:lever:1379269e-57b0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Strategic Program Manager based in the United States or Canada. The Strategic Program Manager will play a pivotal role in executing cross-functional initiatives that support the growth of a new managed business. You will translate strategic priorities into structured plans, coordinate complex workstreams, and drive initiatives from planning through delivery. The role combines rigorous program management with strategic thinking, business curiosity, and sound judgment. You will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to challenge assumptions, clarify priorities, and surface critical tradeoffs. Success will depend on your ability to bring structure to ambiguity, create accountability, and keep teams focused on measurable outcomes. This is an opportunity to help establish scalable operating practices while contributing to the development of a new market category. The position is remote and offers an environment where ownership, collaboration, and a bias toward action are highly valued. Lead complex, cross-functional programs from planning through delivery, establishing clear scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, owners, dependencies, and success metrics. Develop and maintain program plans, tracking mechanisms, status reports, and other execution artifacts. Identify risks early and drive appropriate resolution while maintaining a strong focus on execution quality, timelines, and measurable results. Continuously improve program management processes, tools, and team effectiveness as the business scales. Requirements: 8–10+ years of experience in program management, project management, or cross-functional program leadership. Proven experience managing complex programs involving multiple stakeholders, workstreams, dependencies, and competing priorities. Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to establish structure and maintain momentum across several initiatives simultaneously. Experience developing and maintaining program plans, tracking tools, status reporting, and execution frameworks. Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and hold teams accountable without direct authority. jobgether-jobgether:lever:207d0b5c-89cf-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Chile. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. The role combines business analysis, data security, infrastructure, and stakeholder management in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business units, systems, processes, and workflows, identifying areas of heightened security risk. Analyze data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure data management solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state data storage, access, and usage models. Evaluate viable solutions, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management approaches, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering risk, cost, operational impact, and user adoption. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions across departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with applicable data policies. Present analysis, findings, and recommendations clearly to technology leadership and other key stakeholders. Support the development of a migration roadmap, including dependencies, priorities, adoption, and change management considerations. Contribute to the design and documentation of privileged access management (PAM) processes and frameworks as part of broader data security initiatives. Support the development of auditing and compliance review processes covering data usage, access controls, and end-to-end data security. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline. 5–7+ years of professional Business Analyst experience, ideally with a strong background in data governance, data classification or sensitivity assessments, secure data storage, or IT infrastructure and endpoint initiatives. Demonstrated experience working in complex, multi-platform, enterprise-level environments and analyzing systems usage and data flows across multiple business units. Familiarity with VDI concepts and platforms such as Citrix, VMware Horizon, or Azure Virtual Desktop, or a proven ability to quickly understand and work within new technical domains. Strong experience conducting stakeholder interviews, facilitating requirements-gathering sessions, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Ability to develop use cases, cost-benefit analyses, business cases, and executive-ready documentation. jobgether-jobgether:lever:25670c77-42ed-.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform
jobgether-jobgether:lever:25670c77-42ed-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in Kenya. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality. Extend instrumentation across Python, Go, and Rust components in collaboration with product engineering teams. Consolidate existing dashboards, queries, and reporting mechanisms into a smaller, more reliable observability platform, retiring tooling that does not provide meaningful operational value. Implement symptom-based, SLO-driven alerting with multi-window burn-rate principles and clear page, ticket, and dashboard classifications. Ensure every production alert has a defined owner, documented failure mode, and actionable runbook. Establish ongoing alert-quality practices, including periodic reviews, measurable actionable-alert rates, and deliberate removal of unnecessary alerts. Build a machine-readable ownership and escalation model that routes incidents to the appropriate engineering squads. Establish severity definitions, acknowledgement expectations, follow-the-sun escalation practices, and clean handoff procedures across multiple time zones. Strengthen incident command and blameless postmortem practices, including reliable timelines, ownership, and follow-through on corrective actions. Coach engineering squads to own their own operational responsibilities and paging rather than becoming a centralized buffer for other teams' alerts. Deliver measurable reliability outcomes over the first year, including complete SLI ownership, production telemetry, tiered alerting, squad on-call adoption, and a significant reduction in the time required to detect silent security-control degradation. Requirements Substantial production engineering or SRE experience, including experience defining and implementing an SLO framework rather than simply operating within an existing one. Strong Python skills and the ability to read and modify Go or Rust code when implementing instrumentation and reliability improvements. Strong hands-on experience with time-series and event telemetry at scale, including Prometheus/OpenMetrics, Grafana, Alertmanager-class routing systems, and columnar or high-cardinality data stores such as ClickHouse or equivalent technologies. Experience debugging distributed systems running on bare metal and long-lived hosts; this role requires more than Kube

Continuously evaluate architecture, infrastructure performance, stability, developer experience, and operational processes.
